notes.title: Nofio Valve Index Software Release v2.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Nofio devices software:[/b]

[b]WIFI drivers update and stability improvements[/b]

- QCA2066 Driver Update
- Config updates
	- This should reduce CPU utilisation on the head device.
	- It should also reduce severity of latency spikes on the head device.

Updated drivers and optimised configs will result in minor improvements to stability and performance of the wireless connection.

Its intention apart from the wireless module driver update, is to lay foundation for the next update which tackles the 'red screen' issue on the head side.

For further assistance, refer to our official nofio FAQ. https://nofio.co/pages/faq-1 Should you encounter any issues with this update, kindly submit a ticket through our support portal on our website www.nofio.co. If possible, please attach a Diagnostic & Steam Report.

notes.title: Nofio for the Valve Index - Software Release v2.4.0
notes.content:
Nofio for the Valve Index Software Release v2.4.0

Nofio devices software:

Feature:

- Nofio head unit now controls power to the Valve Index HMD and will power it depending if the nofio head unit is off/on.
This saves battery usage when users forget to unplug the power cable after finishing a nofio session.
Nofio head unit will power off the Valve Index HMD when powering off, and power it on once the nofio head unit has booted.

**This build also contains firmware changes to support future planned improvements for the re-timer.


For further assistance, refer to our official nofio FAQ. https://nofio.co/pages/faq-1 Should you encounter any issues with this update, kindly submit a ticket through our support portal on our website www.nofio.co. If possible, please attach a Diagnostic & Steam Report.

notes.title: Nofio for the Valve Index Software Release v2.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]Nofio for Index Software Release v2.3.1[/h1]

[b]Nofio devices software:[/b]

[b]Feature: [/b]Nofio Internal Logging Utility - Additional Functionality

- Nofio head unit will now stream internal debug data to the base unit when Diagnostic Logging is enabled in Nofio Utility App (NUA) settings.
    - Nofio head will still retain local log, data being streamed to base unit is done to capture data on the "Red screen" issue.
    - Nofio devices will only capture data when 'Diagnostic Logging' option is enabled in NUA settings. On reboot/crash/loss of power of these devices, these logs will be reset.
    - Nofio devices ONLY capture data from the nofio devices themselves. No other data is collected.

For further assistance, refer to our official nofio FAQ. https://nofio.co/pages/faq-1 Should you encounter any issues with this update, kindly submit a ticket through our support portal on our website www.nofio.co. If possible, please attach a Diagnostic & Steam Report.

notes.title: Nofio for Index Software Release v2.3.0
notes.content:
Nofio devices software:
[b]Feature: [/b]Nofio Internal Logging Utility
- Nofio now has the ability to capture diagnostic data internally only. The 'diagnostic logging' option must be enabled via Nofio Utility App (NUA) for the utility to function.
    - When set to True, the internal logger utility will capture data up to 10hrs of gameplay at 1sec intervals on a rolling buffer. Log captures will be exported along with the diagnostic report.
    - Internal logs will be reset on reboot for the respective Nofio device.
    - Internal logging utility will ONLY capture data from the Nofio hardware. No other data capture is done.

For further assistance, refer to our official nofio FAQ. https://nofio.co/pages/faq-1 Should you encounter any issues with this update, kindly submit a ticket through our support portal on our website www.nofio.co. If possible, please attach a Diagnostic & Steam Report.

notes.title: Nofio Utility app & Device Software Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Nofio Utility App[/h1]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]The status display will update to match SteamVR's "Standby" state.Note, this is a cosmetic change; just so it's easier to see what state the system is in!
[*]If, after a firmware update, your hardware does not re-connect to the app after 3 minutes, you can now cancel out of the install process and view the logs.Usually, you will just need to manually reboot your hardware. Guidance is provided in-app for this situation!
[/list]
 
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Uninstalling the Nofio driver now first shuts down USB support so that it can complete the uninstall without requiring a system reboot.
[*]The battery status prompt no longer gets stuck when switching from a Nofio battery to a third-party one.
[*]The app's dependencies are now bundled directly, meaning first-time install issues should be resolved.
[/olist]
 

[h1]Nofio Device Software[/h1]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] WiFi channel selection via Nofio App. Allowing the capability for users to switch wireless channels given their country's regulatory domain specifications.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nofio incorrect battery reading. Now the Nofio will verify the update value is correctly read before updating the battery value.
[/list]
